newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Morgan Stanley cuts Taiwan investment ratio - paper.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley cuts Taiwan investment ratio - paper.

text.p: U.S. Investment bank Morgan Stanley has lowered its holding ratio in Taiwan stocks to four percent from six percent, the Economic Daily News reported on Monday.

The newspaper quoted a Morgan Stanley investment report as saying that Taiwan's stock market value has reached high levels, but listed firms' profit performance failed to catch up with its high market value.
The report suggested investors put four percent of their money in Taiwan, down from six percent, the paper said.
But Taiwan's liquidity remains loose, and liquidity-driven gains may continue, the paper quoted the report as saying.
Morgan Stanley was not immediately available for comment.
